# Ace Group (Ace the Academia)

> Ace Group of Companies is a South African venture group, established in 2024, operating five divisions across education, software development, AI automation, transportation and educational technology. Trading academy brand: Ace the Academia. The group builds practical products for real-world impact, designed for South African users, infrastructure and operating conditions.

## About

- Name: Ace Group of Companies (also "Ace Group"); academy brand "Ace the Academia"
- Founded: 2024, South Africa
- Focus: useful products, careful delivery and measurable outcomes
- Contact: aceacademia2022@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ace-the-academia/

## Divisions

- [Education](https://acesoftwares.tech/divisions/education): Transformative learning programmes, academic support and institutional training.
- [Software Development](https://acesoftwares.tech/divisions/software-development): Bespoke web, mobile and enterprise systems from concept to deployment.
- [AI and Automation Engineering](https://acesoftwares.tech/divisions/ai-automation): AI workflows, agents and automation systems that reduce manual work.
- [eHailing and Transportation](https://acesoftwares.tech/divisions/ehailing-transportation): Mobility, driver tools and transport technology for South African routes.
- [Educational Technology](https://acesoftwares.tech/divisions/educational-technology): Digital learning platforms, assessment tools and learner analytics.

## Programmes

- [AI n8n Automation Bootcamp](https://acesoftwares.tech/events): 6-week live online programme (via Zoom), 1 August - 6 September 2026. Current price: R720. Register via WhatsApp (+27 73 929 8456) or pay via iKhokha.

## Tutoring

- [Online Tutoring](https://acesoftwares.tech/tutoring): Online tutoring by Ace the Academia for Grade 11, Grade 12, matric-upgrade and university students. High-school focus: Mathematics, Mathematical Literacy, Physical Sciences. University focus: UWC Computer Science, Statistics and first/second-year Mathematics. Formats: one-on-one, group classes and weekend exam bootcamps. Delivered online via Zoom or Google Meet; register on WhatsApp.
